quote: we propose to employ a query generator in the cross-lingual setting, which uses the likelihood of a query against a passage to measure the relevance.

We employ mT5 as the query generator. The query generator has two roles: teacher and generator. As a teacher, it aims to better re-rank the candidate passages with relevance and distill the knowledge to the dual-encoder. As a generator, it aims to generate synonymous queries in different languages.
